assertions: Indiscriminate Response Team shuffles Runner's grip into the stack after a successful run and draws the same number of cards without exposing hidden card identities.
London City Grid is a region upgrade and increases the cost of noisy icebreaker subroutine use by one during runs on its fort.
Satellite Monitors rolls one deterministic die per Runner run attempt from the previous turn and gives one tag for each roll of 1.
Self-Destruct can be installed only in a subsidiary data fort and, when accessed, taps itself, trashes other installed cards in that fort, and deals matching Net damage.
Shock Treatment trashes all installed Runner hardware and two installed programs on access only when Runner has at least four tags.
Sterdroid spends three credits, taps, targets a rezzed installed ICE, and doubles its strength until end of turn with a cap of 10.
Strategic Planning Group draws one extra Corp card whenever the Corp draws and bottoms one drawn card while preserving hidden R&D/HQ information.
Street Enforcer taxes each run on its fort by Runner's current tag count.
